name: opensheets-finance
description: Local MCP server for the Opensheets personal-finance app.
long_description: Exposes the Opensheets finance tools (reports, lookups, transaction/transfer creation, invoice payment, OFX/CSV import) to a Claude Desktop client over stdio. The server talks directly to the same PostgreSQL database as the web app; it does not open a network port. Writes are gated by OPENSHEETS_MCP_WRITE_MODE (readonly | safe-writes | full) and every mutation is audited and idempotent.

database_url.title: PostgreSQL connection string
database_url.description: postgres://user:pass@host:port/database — the same database the web app uses.

user_id.title: Opensheets user ID (optional)
user_id.description: UUID from the user table. Set THIS or user email — not both.

user_email.title: Opensheets user email (optional)
user_email.description: Login email. Set THIS or user ID — not both.

write_mode.title: Write mode
write_mode.description: readonly (default), safe-writes, or full. Start with readonly. High-risk tools (delete, reversal, invoice payment, series edit, anticipation, import apply) require full.

import_dir.title: OFX/CSV import directory (optional)
import_dir.description: Absolute path finance_import_preview may read files from. Leave empty to accept only base64 content.
